reasons.text: About 32% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
In years with a hot July (corn flowering), corn yields here tend to be about 24 bu/ac lower.
In years with little rain from April to September, corn yields here tend to be about 8 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is July heat: from about -32 bu/ac in 2011 to about -2 bu/ac in 2014.
